title: A drawer for every unfinished idea.
author: dachi
summary: Some projects need a breakthrough. Others first need a labelled drawer. A small improvement to keeping the workbench usable.
mediaAlt: Labelled project drawers stacked in the laboratory.
content:
## A little structure for the chaos

This is a workshop for experiments at different stages. Giving parts and project assemblies a visible home makes it easier to put a build down and return to it.

The labels will change as the projects do. The useful part is being able to find the thing you were certain you left right here.
